correctness.rationale: PASS: Exterior normal triangle side lengths are pi-theta and lie [ell=pi/2-delta,u=pi-alpha]. Since the normal triangle has s<pi, L’Huilier applies. For a>=b>=c, s>=3ell/2, s-a>=(alpha-2delta)/2, and s-b,s-c>=ell/2, giving E_v>=4 arctan(tan(ell/4)*sqrt(tan(3ell/4)*tan((alpha-2delta)/4))). Vertex normal fan partitions 4pi and simple-polytope Euler gives V=2F-4, yielding bound. Local near-degenerate triangle (2ell-eps,ell,ell) has area proportional sqrt(eps) by L’Huilier; no claim of globally sharp facet rate. Independent spherical cosine/L’Huilier comparisons and octant sanity checks pass; samples alone not proof.
